item.title: Barcelona to remain on F1 calendar in rotation with Spa-Francorchamps
item.description: Despite losing the Spanish Grand Prix to Madrid, Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya will remain on the F1 calendar, albeit in rotation with Spa-Francorchamps.

item.title: IndyCar to mandate two stints on alternate tires for street races
item.description: After a trial at last year's Indy GP, IndyCar is doubling the number of required stints on alternate tires on street courses this year.

item.title: Daytona delivers the most meaningful of moments with Reddick's victory
item.description: After a tough time off-track for Tyler Reddick, 23XI and its co-owner Denny Hamlin, the Daytona 500 provided a perfect start to the season for them.

item.title: Foyt and Penske technical alliance to continue
item.description: AJ Foyt Racing will continue to benefit from a partnership with Team Penske until at least the end of 2027.
